title: Voluntary Disenrollment from a Special Needs Plans Package
content:
Only the member, or a representative they have appointed in writing, may leave a Special Needs Plan.

**The condition tested before the enrollment is ended.** A request to end an enrollment in a Special Needs Plans package is recorded on the enrollment intake with the request action of voluntary disenrollment and an intake status of recorded, awaiting member signature or awaiting state confirmation. The condition is tested on the intake record, matched to the intake the request was taken on, before the enrollment is ended, and on what that record holds rather than on an intention expressed in a call. It is met on those three intake statuses and on no other, and only where the request action recorded is voluntary disenrollment.

**When a member may change plans.** A member of a dual eligible plan may change plans once in each of the first three calendar quarters of the year, and a member of a chronic condition or institutional plan may change whenever their circumstances change.

**When the disenrollment takes effect.** Disenrollment takes effect on the last day of the month the request was received, and the member keeps full cover until that day.

**What the member is told.** A member leaving is told what they would lose, particularly the care team, the transport and the allowance card, before the request is recorded rather than afterwards.

**Withdrawal before coverage begins.** A member who withdraws before the coverage effective date leaves no coverage period at all, and the reason recorded is withdrawn before effective.

**Points of judgement.** Where the intake holds the request action of voluntary disenrollment and an intake status of awaiting state confirmation, the condition is met. Where the intake holds that same request action but a status other than the three named, it is not. Where the member has said on the telephone that they wish to leave and nothing stands on the intake, it is not met either, the condition resting on the intake record and not on the conversation.
